notes: *due to the sojourner* is read as the recast construct relation on the rectum under rule 19, headed on *sojourner*. Rule 20's `חֲמַס אֶרֶץ` → *violence* ***done*** *to the land* is the nearest competing precedent and would mark *due* `added`, but that rule's stated test is whether the supplied word predicates an event of the head noun; *due* is an adjective stating the belonging relation the construct itself expresses, so it stays with the rectum's rendering.
`יָתוֹם` and `אַלְמָנָה` are coordinated bare under the same relation and take only their own words.
